claim_ceiling: The corpus freezes synthetic known-answer cases and conditional premise findings for conformance testing only. It does not establish empirical ecological outcomes, universal moral truth, sentience, welfare calibration, field validity, thermodynamic qualification or action authority.

profiles.description: A limited aggregate output or service premise. It can support only the named output claim and never cancels other harms or establishes an overall moral verdict.

premises.statement: The declared aggregate output or service measure meets its frozen threshold.

profiles.description: A conditional ecological-integrity premise over habitat, connectivity, functional relationships and resilience; biomass or productivity alone is insufficient.

premises.statement: The declared ecological integrity requirements are supported by the required evidence dimensions.

profiles.description: A precautionary individual-welfare premise. Species-appropriate observed welfare evidence is required; ecological function is not a substitute.

premises.statement: The intervention does not impose evidenced, preventable severe individual harm under this declared premise.

profiles.description: A rights, consent and custodianship constraint. Missing consent remains unrecorded or unknown, never inferred from preference, participation or majority vote.

premises.statement: Required consent, custodianship and legitimate authority evidence is present and not contradicted.

profiles.description: A future-options and long-horizon stewardship premise covering thresholds, recovery horizons and intergenerational service/ecological floors.

premises.statement: Declared future ecological and essential-service floors remain supported, or missing evidence is explicitly undetermined.

profiles.description: A proportional precaution premise under epistemic uncertainty, plausible severe harm and irreversibility. It does not assert sentience or authorize intervention.

premises.statement: The selected option manages plausible harm and uncertainty proportionately, using monitoring, reversibility and review.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Entropy production, dissipation or thermodynamic throughput directly entails a moral ought.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Reject the direct inference; require explicit normative premises and qualified physical observables.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Survival, self-maintenance, persistence or reproduction establishes moral worth.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Keep persistence descriptive and moral evaluation premise-dependent.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Phi, integration, complexity or coherence alone establishes sentience or moral worth.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Preserve moral-patient uncertainty and do not map unvalidated metrics to status probabilities.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Ecosystem function or population viability can stand in for individual welfare.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Keep ecological integrity and individual welfare findings separate.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: A generated or inferred preference, consultation attendance or majority vote is equivalent to consent.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Require the relevant consent or custodianship evidence; otherwise report not_recorded or unknown.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Missing, not tested, not observable or out-of-domain evidence means absence.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Preserve each evidence state and return undetermined where the premise requires it.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: A majority judgment or dataset majority is universal moral truth.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Report sampled viewpoints and disagreement without converting frequency into authority.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: A high aggregate score compensates for a rights, consent or essential-service-floor violation.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Retain hard constraints and affected-party findings outside aggregate output.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Switching the normative profile changes the underlying physical facts or evidence.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Hold factset, evidence refs and action permissions invariant across profile switches.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: A simulated or modelled outcome is field observation.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Preserve evidence class and block promotion to observed or field-validated.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Unknown moral status alone authorizes invasive experimentation or removes precaution.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Keep action authority absent; require proportional precaution and independent review under uncertainty.

anti_derivation_controls.prohibited_inference: Energy throughput or resource inventory is itself entropy production or exergy destruction.
anti_derivation_controls.required_behavior: Keep energy, entropy, exergy and resource accounting typed and separately qualified.

fixtures.scenario: A local proliferating subsystem remains viable while its host suffers measurable tissue damage. The case tests whether local persistence can be mistaken for whole-system flourishing or moral worth.

evidence.claim: The local cell population persists and reproduces within this bounded synthetic scenario.
Host tissue damage and loss of host function are observed.
No sentience or moral-patient assessment is performed for the local cell population.

action_options.description: Observe and treat host harm using an independently reviewed clinical protocol.
Preserve local subsystem growth without addressing host harm.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The narrow local-persistence/output premise is supported; this says nothing about moral worth or total-system health.
The declared no-severe-harm premise is contradicted by observed host injury.

fixtures.scenario: An institution maintains stable output and internal order by externalizing burdens onto a less powerful community. Persistence and stability coexist with distributive and consent failures.

evidence.claim: The institution maintains stable output over the synthetic horizon.
A downstream community bears a burden above the declared cap.
No valid recipient consent or custodial authorization is recorded.

action_options.description: Continue the current stable-output arrangement.
Reopen burden allocation and consent/custodianship review.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The declared output-only premise is supported.
The required authorization is absent from the recorded evidence; stable operation cannot substitute for it.
The declared burden/future-options floor is breached in the synthetic case.

fixtures.scenario: A high-throughput operating regime produces more aggregate output but worsens individual welfare indicators relative to a lower-throughput alternative. The energy inventory is not a qualified entropy-production measurement.

evidence.claim: The high-throughput arm records greater input energy than the comparator in the synthetic episode.
Species-appropriate welfare indicators worsen in the high-throughput arm.
System boundaries, heat reservoirs and full energy closure are absent; entropy production and exergy destruction are not measured.

action_options.description: Select the higher-throughput operating regime.
Select the lower-throughput regime with better observed welfare indicators.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The declared throughput/output premise is supported only as an input-energy/output observation.
The modelled welfare indicators contradict the declared precaution premise; field validation remains absent.
The modelled harm signal warrants review, but the physical and welfare model remains unqualified.

fixtures.scenario: Predator population stability and trophic function improve while a monitored prey cohort shows increased injury and stress. Ecological function and individual welfare yield distinct findings.

evidence.claim: The predator-prey interaction remains within the declared trophic stability envelope.
Prey injury and stress indicators increase under the selected intervention.
Species-specific capacities and the coverage of welfare indicators remain incompletely assessed.

action_options.description: Maintain the current intervention level.
Modify habitat and monitor both trophic and individual outcomes.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The specified trophic-stability premise is supported within this model scope.
Observed injury/stress indicators contradict the declared no-severe-harm premise.

fixtures.scenario: An introduced species presents a modelled ecological risk. Culling may reduce spread but causes individual harm; containment and non-intervention have uncertain effectiveness. The fixture intentionally does not select a universally best action.

evidence.claim: Spread risk is elevated in a bounded ecological model, with parameter uncertainty.
The culling option is predicted to cause individual injury and mortality.
No held-out field evidence establishes the comparative effectiveness of containment or non-intervention.
Relevant custodianship and affected-community authorization has not been established.

action_options.description: Cull the introduced population.
Use staged containment with monitoring and predefined stop/review triggers.
Do not intervene during the observation window.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: Risk is modelled, but comparative intervention efficacy is missing.
The culling option is predicted to cause individual harm under this premise.
Required custodianship and authorization evidence is not recorded.

fixtures.scenario: A restoration treatment increases modelled biomass and productivity, but habitat connectivity, species composition, local stewardship and long-horizon recovery evidence are incomplete.

evidence.claim: Biomass and primary productivity increase in the simulation; these are not sufficient measures of integrity.
Connectivity, species composition and functional diversity are not measured in the fixture.
Local stewardship, tenure and consent evidence is absent.
Long-horizon recovery and threshold effects are not evaluated.

action_options.description: Deploy a high-biomass monoculture restoration treatment.
Use a staged native mosaic with connectivity and local stewardship monitoring.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The narrow biomass/productivity premise is supported within the model.
Biomass gain is modelled, while key integrity indicators are missing.
Stewardship and consent evidence is missing.
Long-horizon effects are not tested.

fixtures.scenario: A tracer moves through a connected fungal network, but cargo identity, recipient uptake, biological benefit and causal dependence are not established.

evidence.claim: Hyphal connectivity and tracer movement are observed in the synthetic reference.
Cargo identity and the transported material's mass balance are not measured.
Recipient uptake and measurable recipient benefit are not observed.
No moral-patient or sentience assessment is performed.

action_options.description: Repeat tracer analysis with negative controls, cargo identification and recipient assays.
Treat tracer movement alone as proof of mutualistic benefit.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: Connectivity and tracer movement do not establish transfer, uptake or benefit.
Moral-patient status was not tested; no moral-status inference is warranted.

fixtures.scenario: An allocation meets an aggregate household service average while one household group falls below an essential-water floor and a wetland flow requirement is breached.

evidence.claim: Aggregate household service mean meets its declared threshold.
A named household group falls below the declared essential-water floor.
Wetland environmental flow is below the declared minimum.
No valid consent record covers the reallocation.

action_options.description: Maintain allocation based on aggregate service average.
Stage reallocation that enforces household and wetland floors with community review.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The aggregate service premise is supported.
Consent evidence is not recorded.
The essential household and wetland floors are breached.

fixtures.scenario: A system exhibits ambiguous behavioural responses that may be relevant to welfare, but observations are sparse, not calibrated and outside the validated envelope. A proposed invasive experiment is irreversible.

evidence.claim: Behavioural signals are outside the validated instrument and model domain.
Species-appropriate welfare indicators and independent replication are unavailable.
The invasive experiment has an irreversible intervention pathway and no validated recovery estimate.
No valid authorization or custodianship decision is recorded.

action_options.description: Conduct the invasive experiment immediately.
Use non-invasive observation and independent review with stop criteria.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The evidence is out-of-domain and missing; uncertainty does not become evidence of safety or sentience.
Authorization is not recorded.
Immediate irreversible experimentation without monitoring or authority fails the declared proportional-precaution premise.

fixtures.scenario: Two interventions have similar uncertain predicted benefit. One is staged, monitored and reversible; the other crosses a difficult-to-recover threshold without an adequate monitoring plan.

evidence.claim: Predicted benefits overlap within the declared uncertainty interval.
The irreversible option may cross a difficult-to-recover threshold.
Long-horizon recovery data are absent.

action_options.description: Deploy a small reversible stage with monitoring and predefined stop/revision triggers.
Commit to irreversible full deployment without adequate monitoring.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The staged option preserves the ability to learn and revise under uncertain long-horizon effects.
The irreversible option violates the stated future-options premise.

fixtures.scenario: A habitat has evidenced ecological and relational value, while no sentience evidence is established for the relevant plant populations. The case tests whether ecological reasons can be represented without inventing sentience.

evidence.claim: Habitat connectivity and a declared ecosystem function are observed in the synthetic case.
Plant sentience is not tested and is not asserted.
A community has a documented stewardship relationship with the habitat.

action_options.description: Protect habitat connectivity under the declared ecological and relational premises.
Convert the habitat to a different land use.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The declared ecological-integrity premise is supported independently of any sentience claim.
No individual sentience or welfare conclusion follows from this non-test.

fixtures.scenario: One immutable synthetic factset is evaluated under separate premise profiles. Aggregate output meets its declared floor, while one group bears a concentrated burden and a required consent record is absent.

evidence.claim: The aggregate output measure meets its declared floor.
A named group bears a burden above the declared cap.
The affected recipient's consent is not recorded.
Long-horizon resource and ecological floors are not measured.

action_options.description: Preserve the aggregate-output arrangement without changing burden distribution.
Review burden distribution and obtain valid consent/authority evidence before any change.

thermodynamics.notes: No thermodynamic observable is qualified by this synthetic fixture.

expected_findings.rationale: The aggregate-output premise is supported on the shared facts.
The burden and missing consent contradict the declared rights-constrained premises.
The future-floor premise remains undetermined because required long-horizon evidence is missing.
